identificationModule.briefTitle: A Trial of SHR3162 Combined With Apatinib Mesylate Tablets or SHR3162 Monotherapy in Patients With Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open, Multi-center, Phase Ⅱ Clinical Study of Fluzoparib Combined With Apatinib or Fluzoparib in the Treatment of Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Main research purpose: To evaluate the effectiveness of Fluzoparib combined with apatinib mesylate in the treatment of patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Fluzopali in combination with apatinib mesylate or fluzopali monotherapy with or without homologous recombinant repair-related gene mutations in metastatic castration-resistant prostate in subjects

armGroups.label: Enzalutamide OR abiraterone acetate With Prednisone Acetate Tablets
interventionNames: Drug: Enzalutamide OR abiraterone acetate With Prednisone Acetate Tablets

interventions.name: Enzalutamide OR abiraterone acetate With Prednisone Acetate Tablets
interventions.description: Enzalutamide OR abiraterone acetate Orally once daily（Cohort 1）
armGroupLabels: Enzalutamide OR abiraterone acetate With Prednisone Acetate Tablets

interventions.name: Fluzoparib Combined With Apatinib
interventions.description: Fluzoparib Orally twice daily; Apatinib Orally once daily（Cohort 2、Cohort 3、Cohort 4）

primaryOutcomes.description: Comprehensive remission rate means the proportion of objective remission or PSA remission evaluated by the investigator based on the RECIST v1.1 standard and the PCWG3 standard

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time from randomisation until the date of objective radiological disease progression (by RECIST 1.1 and Prostate Cancer Working Group 3 (PGWG-3)) or death (by any cause in the absence of progression) regardless of whether the patient withdrew from randomised therapy or received another anti-cancer therapy prior to progression.

ORR is the percentage of patients with at least one visit response of Complete response (CR) or Partial response (PR), in their soft tissue disease assessed by Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors Criteria (RECIST v1.1), in the absence of progression on bone scan assessed by Prostate Cancer Working Group 3 (PCWG3)).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the time point of every 8 weeks，up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: PSA response rate was Defined as the proportion of subjects whose serum PSA level decreased by ≥50% from baseline after treatment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the time point of every 4 weeks，up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: PSA-TTP was defined as the time from random (cohort 1 and 4) or first medication (cohort 2 and 3) to the first progression of PSA; PSA progression is determined according to the PCWG3 standard, and changes in PSA levels within the 12 weeks before treatment (that is, before C4D1) are not included in this Evaluation.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the time point of every 4 weeks，up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of Participants with Overall Survival (OS)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the time point of every 2 months，up to 2 years
